title: Joe's Jeans Men's Brixton Straight & Narrow, Mahrez (40W x 34L)

comparisons.notes: Official store. Style TDFMAZ8225, The Brixton Straight & Narrow in Mahrez, 34 inch inseam; size 40 / Mahrez variant available at $168.

writeup: Joe's Jeans' Brixton straight-and-narrow jean in the Mahrez wash, men's 40W x 34L, is $15.99 brand new on Woot. Joe's own store charges $168 for the same style in size 40, so this is about 90% less. It's Kinetic stretch denim with a 34-inch inseam, limited to 10 per customer.
